questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers.

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
questions.explanation: The UK uses the Pound Sterling.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: Which is the densest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system.

questions.question: The Rajya Sabha has a maximum strength of:
questions.explanation: The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250 members.

questions.question: Which amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the "Mini Constitution" for its sweeping changes.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was led by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: The First Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between Babur and:
questions.explanation: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in 1526, founding the Mughal Empire.

questions.question: The concept of "Directive Principles of State Policy" was borrowed from which country?
questions.explanation: The Directive Principles were borrowed from the Irish Constitution.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Which organ in the human body purifies blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter and purify blood.

questions.question: Emperor Ashoka belonged to which dynasty?
questions.explanation: Ashoka was a Mauryan emperor.

questions.question: Light travels fastest in:
questions.explanation: Light travels fastest in a vacuum (~3×10⁸ m/s).

questions.question: Water boils at what temperature at sea level?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at standard sea-level pressure.

questions.question: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India is appointed by the:
questions.explanation: The CAG is appointed by the President of India.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: The currency of Japan is the:
questions.explanation: Japan’s currency is the Yen.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: Which is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: The national animal of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Royal Bengal Tiger is India’s national animal.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: The Sun rises in the:
questions.explanation: Due to Earth’s west-to-east rotation, the Sun appears to rise in the east.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.B: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is the:
questions.explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes.

questions.question: Who is known as the "Father of the Indian Constitution"?
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the drafting committee.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: World Water Day is observed on:
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 45 days?
questions.explanation: 45 mod 7 = 3; Friday + 3 = Monday.

questions.explanation: 7th letter = G; 7 + 5 = 12th letter = L.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.

questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(8² + 15²) = √289 = 17 km.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 8 and their sum is 91. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 13. Each part = 91/13 = 7. Larger = 8 × 7 = 56.

questions.question: A can do a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/24 = 36/288. Time = 288/36 = 8 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 14 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 14² = 616 cm².

Find 10% of 20% of 1100.
Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 7 and their difference is 30. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 30, so each part = 10. Smaller = 4 × 10 = 40.

questions.question: A boat travels 20 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 20/2 = 10 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 10 − 4 = 6 km/h.
